visualSymptoms: Bright yellow, linear stripes of urediniospores on leaf blades
Yellow dusty powder on hands when touching foliage
Premature leaf drying and chlorosis along veins
Stunted spikes with shriveled grains
chemicalTreatment: Spray Propiconazole 25% EC (Tilt) @ 1 ml/litre of water (200 ml/acre) or Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 200 ml/acre in 200L water. Repeat after 15 days if cloudy weather persists.
organicBioControl: Foliar spray of Trichoderma harzianum @ 5g/litre + Neem oil 1500 ppm @ 3 ml/litre. Dusting sulfur @ 10 kg/acre in dry conditions.
preventiveAdvice: Avoid excessive urea application. Maintain field drainage. Inspect northern border areas during cold misty spells.

visualSymptoms: Partial conversion of wheat kernels into black powdery masses
Distinct foul, fishy odor (trimethylamine) in field or storage
Spreading glumes exposing blackened teliospores
chemicalTreatment: Spray Propiconazole 25% EC @ 500 ml/ha at heading/anthesis stage.
organicBioControl: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 4g/kg seed before sowing. Crop rotation with non-host legumes.
preventiveAdvice: Use certified disease-free seed; avoid over-irrigation during anthesis.

visualSymptoms: Pale yellowish-green appearance of older lower leaves first
V-shaped yellowing starting at leaf tips and progressing down the midrib
Reduced tillering and spindly, stunted plant growth
chemicalTreatment: Top dress Urea @ 30-35 kg/acre before first/second irrigation, or foliar spray of 2% Urea solution (2 kg Urea in 100L water per acre).
organicBioControl: Soil application of Jeevamrit @ 200L/acre or Vermicompost @ 5 quintals/acre with Azotobacter biofertilizer.
preventiveAdvice: Split application of nitrogen: 50% basal, 25% at CRI stage, 25% at jointing stage.

visualSymptoms: Spindle-shaped or eye-shaped lesions with grey/white centers and brown margins
Blackened collar rot where leaf sheath meets blade
Broken rotten neck at the base of panicle causing empty white heads
chemicalTreatment: Foliar spray of Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 0.6g/L (120g/acre) or Isoprothiolane 40% EC @ 1.5 ml/L.
organicBioControl: Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10g/L foliar spray + Panchagavya 3% solution at 10-day intervals.
preventiveAdvice: Avoid high doses of nitrogenous fertilizers. Maintain standing water depth at 3-5 cm.

visualSymptoms: Water-soaked stripes turning yellow to wavy white edges on leaves
Milky bacterial ooze beads on lesions early morning
Leaves wilt and roll up, leading to kresek symptom in young plants
chemicalTreatment: Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 500g + Streptocycline @ 6g in 200L water per acre.
organicBioControl: Neem seed kernel extract (NSKE) 5% spray + Bacillus subtilis bio-fungicide @ 5g/L.
preventiveAdvice: Drain the field temporarily if flood irrigation is stagnating. Stop nitrogen top dressing immediately.

visualSymptoms: Rosetted flowers that fail to open properly
Small entry holes bored into developing bolls plugged with excreta
Stained lint and chewed developing seeds inside cut bolls
chemicalTreatment: Spray Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 100g/acre or Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 60 ml/acre.
organicBioControl: Install 8-10 pheromone traps per acre with Gossyplure. Release Trichogramma bactrae egg parasitoids @ 60,000/acre.
preventiveAdvice: Timely destruction of crop residues after harvest; avoid keeping ratoon cotton.

visualSymptoms: Dense colonies of tiny green-black soft-bodied bugs clustered on shoots and flowers
Curled, yellowed inflorescences coated with sticky honeydew and sooty mold
Poor pod filling and shriveled seeds
chemicalTreatment: Spray Dimethoate 30% EC @ 1.5 ml/L or Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 80g/acre in 200L water.
organicBioControl: Spray Verticillium lecanii @ 5g/L or 5% Neem Oil emulsion with soap water solution.
preventiveAdvice: Early sowing before mid-October helps crop escape peak aphid flight periods.

visualSymptoms: Concentric ringed brown/black target-board spots on older leaves
Yellow halo surrounding dark necrotic spots
Leaf premature defoliation under high relative humidity
chemicalTreatment: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L (500g/acre) or Azoxystrobin + Difenoconazole @ 1 ml/L.
organicBioControl: Cow urine spray (10% fermented) + Trichoderma viride @ 5g/L.
preventiveAdvice: Provide adequate spacing between rows to enhance air circulation.
